"Lake George – Autumn, 1927 / Georgia O'Keeffe" (Alfred Stieglitz, graphite) 3. "Lake George – Autumn / 1927 / Georgia O'Keeffe" (William Einstein, Label: stamped, "An American Place / Room 1710— 509 Madison Ave. / New York, — N.Y." (blue-bordered), black ink) 4. cr_data.provenance:
[1] Estate of the artist [1887–1986] (Santa Fe, New Mexico, USA); [2] 1993, Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation (Abiquiu, New Mexico, USA); [3] 1998, purchased by Jane Bradley Pettit Foundation (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) and gift to Milwaukee Art Museum (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1], [2] Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press; Washington, DC: National Gallery of Art; Abiquiu, NM: The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, 1999), p. 355, cat. 607. 
[3] Documentation in MAM object file 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946" [note of inscriptions 1, 2]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Dated by O'Keeffe in 1957. Betty Pilkington." Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1922. Stretcher inscription 1 and backing inscriptions 2, 3 date 1927. Dated 1927 on basis of inscriptions and inclusion in 1928 exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
